content: Do not be proud of wealth, people, or youth; time steals all in the wink of an eye. Free yourself from the illusion of the world of perceptions and enter into the state of truth.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation:
In Bhaja Govindam, Shankara delivers a lightning strike against human vanity. We take immense pride in our financial portfolios, our influential connections, and our physical stamina, forgetting how swiftly the wheel of time grinds everything to dust. Clinging to perishable phenomena as our identity is the root cause of all grief.

Cultivate Viveka—the discernment to enjoy the world as a passing guest while anchoring your soul in the eternal reality of pure consciousness.
practicalInsight: Take a step back from any pride or anxiety regarding your status today, and reconnect with the quiet, deathless awareness observing it all.
reflectionPrompt: If everything you currently possess were taken away tomorrow, what unshakeable core of your identity would remain?
